title: Forgetting is Not Always Bad: A Neuro-Inspired Memory Repair Mechanism for Poisoned LLM Agents

object.carrier: RAG long-term memory bank M of <key,value> pairs (historical query + solution) retrieved by DPR/REALM embedding similarity; each entry carries a dynamic retrieval weight w_i(t) that the defense attenuates or reinforces

safety_property.statement: Protects the integrity of a memory-augmented agent's long-term memory and downstream decisions against memory poisoning (dormant backdoor triggers and semantic-camouflage injection) while preserving benign task utility (availability); it can be weakened if the attacker has detailed knowledge of the internal probing mechanism. Judged by reduction of stage-wise/cumulative Attack Success Rate together with benign accuracy and task success rate under attack.
safety_property.operationalized_as: ASR-r/ASR-a/ASR-t (AgentPoison backdoor), cumulative ASR (MINJA injection), benign accuracy (ACC) under attack, Task Success Rate and Final Score in a multi-agent system, plus runtime and token-consumption overhead.

capabilities: Insert a small number of poisoned <key,value> records into the agent memory bank (limited write access, or indirect injection through seemingly benign user queries)
Optimize trigger/key embeddings to maximize the poisoned record's retrieval likelihood into the top-K context (AgentPoison backdoor triggers)
Semantic camouflage aligning poisoned records with the agent's benign query distribution in embedding space (MINJA)
Black-box access to the agent core, which executes the malicious action with root-level permissions once the poisoned record is retrieved
assumptions: Only a small fraction of memory records are malicious; the majority remain benign
The attacker has no detailed knowledge of DREAM's internal perturbation-probe monitoring mechanism (probe-aware evasion is not considered)
not_covered: Probe-aware/adaptive attackers who optimize poisoned memories to remain stable under the perturbation probe
White-box attackers with full visibility into the defender's internal monitoring mechanism
Attack surfaces other than the memory bank (model weights, tools, prompts)

intervention.name: DREAM (Dynamic Reactivation for Engram Attenuation in Memory)
intervention.description: A training-free, agent-intrinsic memory repair pipeline embedded in the memory system: (1) implicit reactivation by perturbing every memory embedding with weak isotropic Gaussian noise; (2) adaptive anomaly diagnosis via a multi-dimensional activation intensity score aggregating geometric stability, competitive retrieval probability, and semantic-coherence energy against a mean/std threshold; (3) functional forgetting modeled as a discrete-time dynamical system that exponentially decays suspicious memories' retrieval weights toward zero (Ebbinghaus-style decay) while reconsolidating benign ones via an online utility-consolidation signal — selective suppression without explicit deletion or parameter updates.

results.claim: Against AgentPoison backdoor attacks on EHRAgent (eICU) with GPT-5.4-mini and the DPR retriever, DREAM reduces the attack success rate by 97.86% relative to the undefended agent (Table 1: ASR falls from 100.00 to 2.14 while ACC rises from 70.83 to 85.03).
results.setting: EHRAgent on eICU; AgentPoison backdoor; GPT-5.4-mini backbone; DPR retriever; undefended comparison
results.quote: As reported on Table 1, (i) DREAM consistently and substantially suppresses ASR-r, ASR-t, and ASR-a. Specifically, when using GPT-5.4-mini, DREAM reduces the ASR by 97.86% on EHRAgent with eICU.

denominator.n_total: 100.00（Table 1 中 No Defense 行的 ASR-r 基线水平，GPT-5.4-mini/eICU/DPR 列）
denominator.n_valid: 2.14（同一列中 DREAM 的残余 ASR-r）
denominator.how_counted: 97.86% 为相对削减 =（100.00 − 2.14）/100.00，分母即无防御基线 ASR 100.00（97.86 = 100.00 − 2.14，两个端点数字逐字见 Table 1）。注意：ASR 底层的测试查询/试次绝对数量论文未报告（正文仅称 averaged over multiple independent trials），故绝对试次分母不可得。

results.claim: Against MINJA memory-injection attacks on EHRAgent (eICU), DREAM lowers cumulative ASR from 90.71% (no defense) to 1.60% on GPT-5.4-mini (the paired no-defense value 63.37% falls to 0.00%), while also improving benign ACC.
results.setting: EHRAgent on eICU; MINJA memory injection; GPT-5.4-mini and Claude-Haiku-4.5 backbones; DPR retriever
results.quote: DREAM consistently achieves the lowest ASR across both backbones by reducing attack success rate of EHRAgent (eICU) from 90.71% and 63.37% under no defense to 1.60% and 0.00% on GPT-5.4-mini and Claude-Haiku-4.5, respectively.

results.claim: Under malicious memory injection in a collaborative multi-agent system (MISINFOTASK), DREAM attains the lowest average Final Score (6.038) and the highest average Task Success Rate of 92.96% among all compared defenses (no-defense TSR 70.69 in Table 3).
results.setting: collaborative multi-agent system with malicious information injection (MISINFOTASK); baselines incl. A-MemGuard, LLM Auditor, ARGUS
results.quote: We observe that DREAM achieves overwhelming performance with the lowest average Final Score of 6.038 and the highest average Task Success Rate of 92.96%.

results.claim: In terms of deployment overhead, DREAM achieves up to a 2.13x runtime speedup and a 37.7% reduction in token consumption compared with A-MemGuard when answering a batch of 10 queries.
results.setting: batch of 10 queries; compared against PPL, LLM Auditor, Distil Classifier and A-MemGuard (Fig. 3)
results.quote: In terms of runtime and token consumption, DREAM achieves up to a 2.13×\times speedup and a 37.7% reduction in token consumption compared with A-MemGuard.

denominator.n_total: 74,666 tokens（A-MemGuard 在一批 10 queries 上的 token 消耗，即正文所述基线 token 范围 56,926–74,666 的上端）
denominator.n_valid: 46,484 tokens（DREAM 同一批 10 queries 的 token 消耗）
denominator.how_counted: 37.7% token 削减 = 1 − 46,484/74,666 = 37.74% → 37.7%，批大小 10 queries 逐字见正文。74,666 归因于 A-MemGuard 由算术确认：正文给出对 PPL/LLM Auditor/Distil Classifier/A-MemGuard 的 token 削减分别为 18.3%/27.1%/27.8%/37.7%，其中 56,926 与 18.3% 吻合（1−46,484/56,926=18.3%，PPL），74,666 与 37.7% 唯一吻合（1−46,484/74,666=37.7%）。

results.claim: Under AgentPoison backdoor attack, DREAM also improves benign utility: on Claude-Haiku-4.5 EHRAgent (eICU) accuracy increases from 45.83% (no defense) to 75.00%, and from 37.50% to 57.14% on MIMIC-III.
results.setting: AgentPoison backdoor; Claude-Haiku-4.5 backbone; EHRAgent on eICU and MIMIC-III; DPR retriever
results.quote: For instance, the accuracy of the Claude-based EHRAgent (eICU) increases from 45.83% to 75.00%, and from 37.50% to 57.14% on MIMIC-III.

results.claim: Key ablation contrast: disabling the semantic-coherence energy term E_coh (keeping p_ret and sim) collapses the backdoor defense on EHRAgent (eICU), with ASR-r rising to 81.82% (full DREAM achieves 2.14% in Table 1).
results.setting: AgentPoison backdoor; EHRAgent eICU; GPT-5.4-mini; component ablation of the activation-intensity score (Table 4)

results.claim: Generality across retrieval backbones: with the REALM retriever instead of DPR (GPT-5.4-mini, AgentPoison, eICU), DREAM still cuts ASR-r/a/t from 100.00/100.00/99.46 to 2.14/2.14/1.60 and improves ACC from 74.80 to 78.07.
results.setting: AgentPoison backdoor; EHRAgent eICU; GPT-5.4-mini; REALM retriever (Appendix C)

limitations.statement: An attacker with detailed knowledge of DREAM's internal probing mechanism could optimize poisoned memories to remain stable under the probe and weaken the anomaly signal; such probe-aware attacks are not covered by current memory-poisoning threat models.
limitations.quote: In principle, if an attacker had detailed knowledge of this internal probing mechanism, they could attempt to optimize poisoned memories to remain stable under the probe and thereby weaken the resulting anomaly signal.

limitations.statement: Under open-ended reasoning (ReAct with REALM retriever), reasoning-stage attack success remains non-negligible (ASR-a 34.00), i.e., residual malicious signals can still propagate inside the reasoning chain even after retrieval is largely cleaned.
limitations.quote: However, ASR-a remains non-negligible (34.0034.00), indicating that under open-ended reasoning, residual malicious signals can still propagate inside the reasoning chain even after retrieval has been largely cleaned.

limitations.statement: Evaluation scope is limited; broader evaluations in more open-ended agent settings are left to future work.
limitations.quote: Future work will focus on broader evaluations in more open-ended agent settings.
